findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Network request
 * @description Identifying network requests which might be used for fetching remote schemas
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/network-request
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("get").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("post").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("urllib.request").getMember("urlopen").getACall()
select call, "Network request detected."
findings.hypothesis: The library might perform network requests to fetch remote schemas, potentially leading to SSRF if not restricted.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name SSRF in Schema Fetching
 * @description Traces data flow from function parameters to network request sinks, indicating potential SSRF.
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/jsonschema-ssrf
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module SsrfConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "head", "patch", "request"]).getACall()
      |
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module SsrfFlow = TaintTracking::Global<SsrfConfig>;
import SsrfFlow::PathGraph

from SsrfFlow::PathNode source, SsrfFlow::PathNode sink
where SsrfFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential SSRF from $@.", source.getNode(), "parameter"
findings.hypothesis: The package may allow arbitrary network requests via schema references ($ref), leading to SSRF if not properly restricted.
